# Writing safe formulas

::: callout-note
**Draft stub.** Scope: user-facing safety. What the `expr` placeholder accepts, the allow-list of operations, and how to write formulas that an end user can edit without exposing your app to arbitrary R evaluation. The internal evaluator design is intentionally out of scope — this chapter is about what a *user* of ggpaintr needs to know to ship a safe app.

Examples follow `book-conventions.md`: each app chunk carries `#| fixture: <slug>` and is mirrored by `tests/fixtures/book-apps/<slug>/app.R`.
:::
